architecture.sharedImplementation: One private loadNativeSource invokes existing linkProject preparation, native unit parse/check and origin mapping. Both exported operations use that single path.
architecture.ephemeral: linkNativeSource:Promise<Linked> returns only the linked object. It never constructs sourceProject/file handles; private successful-unit wrappers and checked bookkeeping have no retained library owner after return.
architecture.retained: openNativeSourceProject:Promise<NativeLinkedSource> explicitly calls sourceProject and retains authentic units/file identities for activation and graph rechecks until close.
architecture.borrowedFrontend: Both operations borrow the injected frontend. The engine keeps its ordinary current arena until reset/close; includeUnits:true still requests detached host migration Programs. Neither absence of .native nor this report is a heap-free or zero-native-memory claim.
architecture.semantics: Path confinement, injected read, profile agreement/override, diagnostics, parser, checker and compiler targets share the unchanged pipeline.
